neighbours.label: the last token of a list item's title, right before the ' - ' / ' – ' separator that introduces its description ('Horton, OR| – This free campsite…', 'Tips (2)| - Advanced…'); needs the list around it
fire:
Free hot springs in Idaho:
- Goldbug Hot Springs – Salmon, ID – A steep two-mile hike to the pools.
- Kirkham – Lowman, ID – Right beside the highway.
- Boat Box – Stanley, ID – A single tub by the river.

The set contains:
- Drill bits (12) - Hardened steel for wood and metal.
- Wall plugs (40) - Fit most masonry.
- Carry case (1) - Holds everything neatly.

Our priorities are:
- Cleaner rivers for the valley - Farms will get help to cut runoff.
- A fairer tax system - Small firms pay less.
- Better care for the elderly - More nurses in every ward.

Useful sites about gardening:
- SeedSwap.org - A place to trade heirloom seeds.
- GrowGuide.com - Planting calendars for every region.
- SoilLab.net - Cheap soil testing by post.

Glossary:
- baht (B) - Basic unit of Thai currency.
- wat - A Buddhist temple compound.
- soi - A side street off a main road.

Shows to watch this month:
- “Dark Harbor” - A detective returns to her home town.
- “The Long Field” - Two brothers inherit a failing farm.
- “Night Ferry” - Strangers are stranded on a crossing.

What we teach:
- Finding maths in daily life – pupils measure, cook and budget.
- Reading for pleasure – every child picks a book.
- Working as a team – projects are shared.

Camping near the lake:
- Loon Point – Ely, MN – Ten sites with fire rings.
- Birch Landing – Tower, MN – Boat ramp and a dock.
- Moose Bay – Orr, MN – No water, bring your own.

notes: One-line items scored near zero in probes and three-item lists 0.44-0.60, so the fire items are whole lists. The near misses give the same content as prose, so the test supports 'list item title before its separator' against prose, not against lists without descriptions.
